scope: 298 executed entries; all shelf inputs end strictly before the breakout signal date; future bars are labels only
method: Describe 5/10/20/40-bar high-low range, close range, nested range contraction, support distance and volume contraction as continuous distributions. Compare winners with no-follow failures without selecting cutoffs.
interpretation: Immediate pre-breakout tightness and dry-up do not separate winners from no-follow failures inside the frozen executed sample. A weak difference at forty bars is insufficient to justify a cutoff, while shorter windows are effectively indistinguishable and recent volume is not lower for winners.
next_action: Study breakout-day demand and leadership as continuous causal evidence. The next question is whether demand expansion relative to the stock's own base and the same-day market explains immediate follow-through; do not add a shelf threshold.
